How It Works

Three stages of intelligent defense.

How Phishing Shield AI evaluates threats transparently without disrupting your normal browsing.

Stage 01

Inspect Structure

When you open a webpage or scan a message, the content script safely extracts the domain, form action targets, input fields, and embedded anchor destinations without modifying page state.

Stage 02

Analyze Threat Signals

Deterministic local heuristics evaluate typosquatting, Cyrillic homoglyphs, and link-text mismatches. On-device Gemini Nano analyzes social engineering patterns while URL reputation checks verified databases.

Stage 03

Explain & Advise

The evidence scoring engine aggregates findings into a calibrated 0–100 score, displays a non-intrusive warning on dangerous pages, outlines deceptive links, and provides one clear actionable instruction.

Implemented Capabilities

Built for precision. Grounded in evidence.

Every feature below is implemented and tested in the codebase today.

🔍

Lookalike-Domain Detection

Levenshtein edit distance, brand keyword squatting, and subdomain masquerading detection that flags domains attempting to impersonate trusted services.

🌐

Unicode & Homoglyph Engine

Unmasks Cyrillic, Greek, and Punycode characters designed to fool the human eye into confusing look-alike characters with Latin letters.

🔗

Deceptive Link Mismatch Flagging

Pinpoints links where visible text displays a trusted domain (e.g. chase.com) while the underlying anchor routes to an attacker's server.

🤖

Chrome Built-in AI (Gemini Nano)

Runs prompt inference on-device using Chrome's built-in AI Prompt API, evaluating social engineering cues locally with zero network round-trip.

🛡️

Shadow DOM Warning Banner

High-risk pages trigger an isolated warning banner injected via Shadow DOM to prevent website CSS conflicts, offering one-click evidence review.

🔐

Privacy PII Redaction

Pre-redacts emails, phone numbers, Luhn-validated credit cards, and auth tokens locally before any optional external lookup occurs.

Chrome Extension

Real-time protection directly in your browser.

The Phishing Shield AI extension runs unobtrusively in your Chrome toolbar. It analyzes active pages in under 15ms and warns you before credentials are compromised.

1.
Build the extension: Run npm run build to produce the ready-to-load dist/ folder.
2.
Load in Chrome: Open chrome://extensions, enable Developer mode, and click Load unpacked.
3.
Browse safely: The extension automatically assesses active tabs and displays risk badges.

Privacy & Trust

Your data stays yours.

We believe security tools should protect privacy, not compromise it.

✓ Stays Purely On-Device

  • • Full webpage HTML and credentials
  • • User passwords, credit card inputs, and OTPs
  • • Local heuristic evaluations (under 15ms)
  • • On-device Gemini Nano Prompt API queries

⚠️ Optional External Lookups

  • • URL reputation queries (stripped of sensitive query tokens)
  • • Cloud Gemini for ambiguous scores (with strict local PII redaction)
  • • Completely disabled when On-Device-Only Mode is enabled
Read our comprehensive threat model and data matrix in docs/PRIVACY.md.
Frequently Asked Questions

Clear answers to common questions.

Phishing Shield AI operates a multi-stage defense pipeline. It starts with deterministic local heuristics checking for typosquatting, Cyrillic homoglyphs, deceptive link text mismatches, and credential harvesting forms. It then combines these signals with Chrome's built-in Gemini Nano model and Google Web Risk reputation databases to calculate an evidence-grounded risk score.
No. In cybersecurity, the absence of known threat indicators does not guarantee safety. We explicitly label low-risk pages as "Safe-looking" rather than "Safe", and always remind users to verify web addresses before entering passwords or payment details.
Never. Our local PII redaction engine ensures passwords, OTPs, session tokens, and credit card numbers are stripped before any external communication. In addition, you can toggle "On-Device-Only Mode" in the extension settings to guarantee zero network calls leave your browser.
Yes! Scroll up to our Live Demo section above. The web demo runs the exact same detection engine in your browser, allowing you to test sample banking, delivery, and account takeover scenarios immediately.

Add Phishing Shield AI to Chrome

Chrome Web Store Submission Prepared

The extension package is built and ready for Chrome Web Store review. To test the live extension right now in Google Chrome:

⬇️ Download Extension Package (.ZIP)
1
Open Extensions Page

In Google Chrome, navigate to chrome://extensions in a new tab.

2
Enable Developer Mode

Toggle the Developer mode switch in the top-right corner of the extensions page.

3
Click "Load unpacked"

Select the extension build folder on your machine:

C:\Users\Nikhil\.gemini\antigravity\scratch\phishing-shield\dist

Or use the packaged archive: dist/phishing-shield-ai-v1.0.0.zip

Once Published: When Google approves the Chrome Web Store listing, clicking Add to Chrome will immediately open the official store page for 1-click installation.
